name: Ghanaian Folklore Narrative Extraction
description: Extracts full-text narrative prose from books containing Twi and English folktales.
extraction_prompt: Analyze the provided page image. If the page is a blank page, cover, or table of contents, return {"results": []}. If the page contains narrative prose (folklore/stories), return the full text of the page as a single entry. Use the following JSON schema: {"results": [{"twi": "..."}]} if the page is in Twi, or {"results": [{"eng": "..."}]} if the page is in English. For Twi text, you must use the current standard orthography (e.g., Bureau of Ghana Languages standard), ensuring that special characters such as 'ɛ', 'ɔ', and 'ŋ' are correctly preserved and used instead of older or simplified ASCII approximations. Maintain original line breaks and paragraph structure within the string. Do not include page numbers or illustration captions in the extracted text unless they are part of the narrative flow. Return ONLY valid JSON.
